coordinates: Metres in the standard YAM station: x forward, y left, z up.

paper.orientation: 210 mm edges parallel to x; sheets aligned; all edges free.
paper.reset_settling: Spawn the still-flat stapled stack 0.5 mm above the tabletop so the clinched wire also clears the table by 0.2 mm. Run gravity/contact settling before the trial; the flexible sheets must drape naturally over the lower clinched tails. Do not start policy control until velocities settle, and do not flatten or pin the sheets. Final settled shape is unvalidated until the coupled paper solver exists.

staple.material: galvanized low-carbon steel; constitutive parameters uncalibrated
staple.installation: Crown midpoint 12 mm inside both nearest sheet edges; two legs pass through both layers and bend inward below the lower sheet. The four original holes must be generated by the installed geometry and recorded, not oversized for extraction.

remover.materials: steel jaws, ABS finger pads, steel return spring
remover.start_orientation: Lying on its left pad, jaw tips point along +y toward the papers.
remover.note: Nominal ordinary-size design; jaw profile and spring/steel response require measured-prop validation. No end-effector attachment or automatic grasp.

assessor_tools: A millimetre ruler, backlight and before/after photographs of both sides of both sheets; not used to help the robot.
